get.description: Returns the full invoice details including line items, amounts, and status. Returns 404 if the invoice does not exist.

get.summary: Downloads the invoice as a PDF document.
get.description: Generates a PDF for the specified invoice using the configured document generator. Returns 404 if the invoice does not exist.

post.summary: Creates a new invoice or credit note.
post.description: Creates a draft invoice or credit note for the current tenant. Credit notes must reference a parent invoice via parentInvoiceId. Line items can be added after creation. Requires tenant context.

get.summary: Returns a filtered, sorted, and paginated list of Invoice entries.
get.description: Executes a dynamic query against Invoice using the Granit query engine. Accepts filter expressions, sort directives, column selection, pagination, and free-text search via query parameters. Returns a PagedResult by default. When the groupBy query parameter is specified, returns a GroupedResult instead (same status code, different shape).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page index. Ignored when cursor is supplied.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: Number of items per page (1-500). Server-side cap applies.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque cursor for keyset pagination. When supplied, overrides page.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Free-text search across searchable columns declared in the query definition.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated sort directives. Prefix a field with '-' for descending (e.g. '-createdAt,lastName').

parameters.name: groupBy
parameters.description: Field to group results by. When set, the response shape becomes GroupedResult instead of PagedResult.

parameters.name: quickFilters
parameters.description: Comma-separated quick-filter names (declared in the query definition).

parameters.name: skipTotalCount
parameters.description: Skip the total row count for faster pagination when the client doesn't need it.

parameters.name: presets
parameters.description: Bracketed preset selectors: 'presets[group]=name'. Applies preset filter groups declared in the query definition.

schema.description: PagedResult when groupBy is absent; GroupedResult otherwise.

post.summary: Finalizes a Draft invoice, assigning a document number and issuing it.
post.description: Transitions a Draft invoice to Open via IWorkflowManager. Generates the next document number via IInvoiceNumberGenerator and snapshots the issuance metadata. Returns 404 if missing, 403 if forbidden, 409 if the invoice is not in Draft.

post.summary: Cancels an Open or Uncollectible invoice.
post.description: Transitions an invoice to Cancelled via IWorkflowManager. The optional Reason is persisted on the workflow transition record (ISO 27001 audit). Returns 404 if missing, 403 if forbidden, 409 if the invoice cannot be cancelled from its current state.

post.summary: Marks an Open invoice as Uncollectible (bad debt).
post.description: Transitions an Open invoice to Uncollectible via IWorkflowManager. The optional Reason is persisted on the workflow transition record. Returns 404 if missing, 403 if forbidden, 409 if the invoice is not in Open state.

get.summary: Returns query metadata for Invoice (columns, filters, sorts, presets).
get.description: Returns the query definition metadata for Invoice: available columns with display labels and data types, supported filter operators, default sort order, presets, and quick filters. Use this to dynamically build query UIs without hardcoding column definitions.

get.summary: Returns the transitions available from the given state for the current user.
get.description: Returns the list of transitions available from the specified current state for the current user, considering their permissions. Transitions where the user lacks the required permission but approval routing is enabled are included with RequiresApproval = true.

post.summary: Evaluates a workflow transition with permission checking and approval routing.
post.description: Attempts to transition from the current state to the target state. Returns the outcome: Completed (direct transition), ApprovalRequested (routed to pending review), Denied (no permission and no approval path), or InvalidTransition (no such transition defined). The caller is responsible for persisting the resulting state on the entity.
